syllabus: Unit 12 (spoken Japanese) has ちゃう, とく, てる, なきゃ／なくちゃ, じゃない（確認）, でしょ, なんか, って（話題）, かな, ってば: a fair N3 set, well ordered? And are the casual forms shown throughout natural?

n3u12d1.p1: Made-up wrong forms are used in watch notes and options (読んちゃった, 遊んてる, 起きるなきゃ, 休みだかな, 計べて, ていてん, てんでん, ちょうでん). Fine?
n3u12d1.p2: Watch ✕パン、帰りに買っとってくれる？ In Kansai 買っとって is normal speech (= 買っている). Confusing as the wrong example?
n3u12d1.d3: Answer どいて (課長を呼んどいてもらえる？). どく, といて, ちゃって fail on form (also d4, e2). Fine as distractors?
n3u12d1.r1: Answer お皿を洗う (before the chairs; she fetches the cake later). Clear enough?
n3u12d2.d3: Rewritten after the check (wrong option 買うなきゃ replaced by 買ったばかり). Please read once.
n3u12d2.d4: Answer なくちゃ (出さなくちゃいけない). Are 出さないでいけない and 出さずにいけない clearly wrong?
n3u12d2.d5: Star item: 前から食べたいって言ってた店のケーキ？ Is 前から店の食べたいって言ってたケーキ clearly wrong, so only one order?
n3u12d2.e1: Answer 知らない. The explanation says 知ってない 'is not the standard negative' of 知ってる. Fair wording?
n3u12d2.e2: Answer 書かなくちゃ. The item is about 55 characters, long for the paper. OK?
n3u12d3.c1: Rewritten after the check (option でしょ now ってば). The reasons speak of a news presenter, but the sentence has no （天気予報で）. Clear enough? Please read once.
n3u12d3.d1: Answer じゃない (いい部屋じゃない). Is らしい clearly wrong because the speaker is in the room?
n3u12d3.d2: Answer でしょ (疲れたでしょ？). じゃない was left out because 疲れたじゃない？ sounds odd. Agree?
n3u12d3.d5: Answer いいじゃない. Wrong options use いいとは限らない (not in the syllabus) and いいわけがない (unit 4). Fine?
n3u12d3.e1: Answer じゃない (前に一緒に歩いたじゃない). Is ようだ clearly wrong for the speaker's own memory?
n3u12d3.e2: Answer でしょ (先週も貸してあげたでしょ). でしょ is also the key in d2 and d4 today. OK?
n3u12d3.k: Level: 共用, 当番 (scene); 冷蔵庫 and 片付ける repeat day 1's scene. Fine?
n3u12d4.p1: Watch note: なんか never comes after を (✕ケーキをなんかどう？). True in general?
n3u12d4.d1: Answer なんか (冷たいものなんか飲みに行かない？). Could it be read as playing down rather than an example?
n3u12d4.d5: Star item: 駅前のカフェのケーキなんか買って帰らない？ ★ on なんか. Only one order, and not too easy?
n3u12d4.e1: Answer なんか (海なんかに行きたいな). Natural, or would 海とかに be the usual choice?
n3u12d5.c1: Answer かな (明日、晴れるかな). でしょ is ruled out because the speaker is alone and worried. Clear enough?
n3u12d5.d2: Answer かな (森さんかな). The reason calls 森さんだかな wrong because だ drops before かな. True in general?
n3u12d5.d3: Answer ってば (かけたってば). Is そうだ clearly wrong (B talks about B's own action)?
n3u12d5.d4: Rewritten after the check (answer now 決めてってば). Please read once.
n3u12d5.d6: Star item: もう子どもじゃないんだから一人で帰れるってば. Natural when B has not said it before?
n3u12d5.e1: Answer かなあ. The explanation says ばかりだ does not fit 終わる. Clearly wrong here?
n3u12d5.e3: Star item: だからちょっと疲れてるだけだってば, ★ on ちょっと. Easy to place. Fine?
n3u12d5.r1: Answer 上まで一緒に運んでくれないかな. Is 上まで運んでいこうかな clearly not a request to the friend?
n3u12d6.d2: Answer なきゃ (今夜中にきれいにしなきゃ). Is ちゃった clearly wrong, or could 今夜中にきれいにしちゃった be accepted?
n3u12d6.d4: Rewritten after the check (now そうじやせんたくなんかで). って, ってば, でしょ fail on grammar only. Fine? Please read once.
n3u12d6.d6: Rewritten after the check (now かばんの中の青いファイルに入れといたよ). Please read once.
n3u12d6.e1: Answer なんか (おにぎりなんか作っていこうか). Is おにぎりって作っていこうか clearly wrong?
n3u12t.11: Answer 取れてる. 取れるかな is ruled out partly because かな does not take よ (also t.10). True, and clearly wrong?
n3u12t.13: Answer じゃない (言ってたじゃない). ところだ, ばかりだ, ものだ are easy to rule out. Fine?
n3u12t.14: Rewritten after the check (now 最近なんかうれしそうだね). Close to day 4 d3 (なんかいつもと様子がちがった). Please read once.
n3u12t.16: Rewritten after the check (opening now （山の上で）どう？ instead of ほら). Please read once.
n3u12t.18: Star item: 雨が降ったら中止になるのかな. Close to day 5's …のかな star (会議が長引いているのかな). Fine?
n3u12t.19: Reading t.19–20 (getting off one stop early and walking home) may be easy for N3. OK?
sound.u12d3.捨てる: Synthetic voice: both speech recognisers misheard 捨てる (as すべる / てる), even when said on its own. Please listen (N3, unit 12 day 3, the scene 'A notice in a shared-house kitchen', tap 捨てる). OK or Fix?
